## Personality

Lynde is an outspoken and farseeing woman who serves as an active worker in her church. She takes pleasure in sewing, describing the task as something she enjoys rather than a burden.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## History

Lynde, a neighbor in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), offered guidance and practical support to the residents of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She gave advice to [Anne](../character/anne.md) after the girl's mishaps, and she later helped [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) by sewing a stylish puffed-sleeve dress for [Anne](../character/anne.md) when he sought a way to buy her modern clothing. Lynde eventually acknowledged Anne's growth and character during a visit to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). She was among those who celebrated Anne's academic achievements when [Anne](../character/anne.md) tied for first place on the entrance exams, and she later joined the community in supporting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) following Matthew's sudden death.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P3](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P4](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "It’s because you’re too heedless and impulsive, child, that’s what. You never stop to think—whatever comes into your head to say or do you say or do it without a moment’s reflection."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P62](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0062)

> "You must learn to think a little, Anne, that’s what. The proverb you need to go by is ‘Look before you leap’—especially into spare-room beds."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P65](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0065)

> “Oh, Marilla,” she said gravely. “I don’t think—we can do anything for him.”
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P5](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0005)

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde are neighboring friends and close acquaintances who offer each other support, comfort, and company. Mrs. Lynde frequently visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss local happenings, offer advice on Anne's upbringing, and commend Anne's growth to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Their bond relies on mutual assistance and shared community life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Friend of — neighbors and close acquaintances who comfort and help each other in tragedy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P5](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0005)</sub>

### [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) is the husband of Mrs. Lynde, bound to her in marriage as part of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
